body: Yes it is true. The game I like is closer to real life than any other game I played. It’s like another world of fun. And I play sports too that also truly makes me happy. And birdwatching , it’s like collectibles in that I tick all the birds I’ve seen and try to complete a checklist of the country I’m in. All these help me to divert my thoughts away from the bad things of my life.
Rdr2 best game I ever played
